notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="RTxQx8qw_Yc;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p]We’ve created an [b]official game trailer[/b] — check it out![/p][/*][*][p]Added an intro cutscene explaining how the player ended up in the ancient castle.[/p][/*][*][p]You will no longer be prompted to return at the end of the game if you have collected all the items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance through geometry optimization.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a short sprint (activated with the Shift key); improved footstep sounds while running.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved German translation — special thanks to [b]Liudmyla Mishchenko[/b] for the help![/p][/*][*][p]Camera shake while walking is now disabled by default (can be changed in the settings).[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugs fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429722/1c315902a67e219199e091c4a2ac3825b82e61a8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now return to the end of the level to collect any skipped items.
[*] Added selection menu to the end screen to prevent the game from ending automatically.
[*] Added hold-to-select option on the end screen to prevent accidental selections.
[*] The Escape key now opens and closes the pause menu.
[*] Menu selection animations have been updated for a smoother and more intuitive user experience.
[/list]
